summary: Subtracts the overlay layer from the fixed layer, clamping negative output values to zero.

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Fixed Layer selection: Input 1 or Input 2.

key_params.name: legacyxform
key_params.note: Use the legacy transform matrix behavior.

common_gotchas: Negative differences are clamped to zero, so signed difference data needs a different workflow.
Fixed Layer changes output resolution/aspect and transform target, not Input1-minus-Input2 order.
Transform parameters affect the overlay/floating layer only.
Legacy Transform changes rotation and transform-order behavior.
key_concepts: Subtract TOP subtracts pixels as Input1 minus Input2, then clamps negative results to zero.
Fixed Layer selects which input defines output resolution and aspect without changing subtraction order.
Transform parameters affect only the overlay layer.
The operator supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
